legal.disclaimer: This text is a draft. Legal review is required before publication.
legal.privacyS1Body: Your personal data is processed by İçinde Ne Var? as the data controller under KVKK (Law No. 6698).
legal.privacyS2Body: Email address, Google/Apple account info, profile preferences, family profiles, scan history, barcodes and product photos, favorites, comparison data, search history, notification preferences, subscription status and device info.
legal.privacyS3Body: Account management, AI-powered product analysis, profile and family-based alerts, comparison and alternatives, ingredient encyclopedia, voice assistant, share card creation, notifications, subscription management and service improvement.
legal.privacyS4Body: Google Gemini API (analysis), Open Food Facts (barcode matching), Supabase (database), Google/Apple (authentication), RevenueCat (subscriptions). AI analysis runs server-side only.
legal.privacyS5Body: Your data is protected with SSL/TLS encryption, row-level security policies (RLS), secure storage for sensitive data, and client-side photo compression before upload.
legal.privacyS6Body: Personal data is deleted within 30 days after account deletion. Barcode-based analyses may be retained as anonymous cache.
legal.privacyS7Body: Under KVKK Article 11, you have rights to access, correction, deletion and objection. Submit requests via app settings or support email.
legal.termsS1Body: An informational app offering product analysis, scoring, family profiles, product comparison, alternative suggestions, ingredient encyclopedia, voice assistant, share cards and scan statistics. Not medical advice.
legal.termsS2Body: Sign in with email OTP, Google Sign-In or Apple Sign-In. You are responsible for data processing of family profiles you create.
legal.termsS3Body: Free plan offers limited daily analyses. Pro subscription (monthly/yearly) includes higher quota, family profiles, comparison, voice assistant and more. Subscriptions auto-renew; cancel via your app store.
legal.termsS4Body: Analyses are performed server-side with AI. Results are informational and may contain errors. If you have allergies or health concerns, check the product label yourself.
legal.termsS5Body: Analyses, scores and suggestions are not definitive health assessments. Alternative suggestions do not guarantee safety. Always consult a professional for health decisions.
legal.termsS6Body: Push notifications are sent with your permission. Barcode-based analyses may be shared anonymously. Photo-based analyses are personal.
legal.termsS7Body: You can delete your account from app settings. If you have an active subscription, you must also cancel it via your app store.
legal.termsS8Body: Terms may be updated; updates take effect upon publication. Continued use means acceptance.
